entities.name: Derived QoS rule
entities.description: A QoS rule created by reflective QoS in the UE based on downlink user data packets received via a PDU session. Contains a QoS flow identifier (QFI), an uplink packet filter, and a precedence value of 80.

entities.name: QoS flow identifier
entities.description: Identifier for a QoS flow within a PDU session.

entities.name: Uplink packet filter
entities.description: Packet filter used for uplink direction in derived QoS rules.

entities.name: Precedence value 80
entities.description: Fixed precedence value of 80 (decimal) assigned to derived QoS rules in the UE.

entities.name: Timer T3583
entities.description: Timer that runs for each derived QoS rule in the UE.

entities.name: Reflective QoS
entities.description: Mechanism where the UE creates derived QoS rules based on downlink user data packets received via a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6 or Ethernet type
entities.description: PDU session types where derived QoS rules are applicable.

entities.name: Not NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Condition where reflective QoS is not supported.

entities.name: Not control plane only PDU session
entities.description: Condition where reflective QoS is not applicable.

relations.description: Reflective QoS procedure creates derived QoS rules in the UE.
Derived QoS rule contains a QoS flow identifier.
Derived QoS rule contains an uplink packet filter.
Derived QoS rule has a fixed precedence value of 80.
Timer T3583 runs for each derived QoS rule.
Reflective QoS is only applicable for PDU sessions of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6 or Ethernet type.
Reflective QoS is not supported in NB-N1 mode.
Reflective QoS is not applicable for PDU sessions with control plane only indication.
